contracts: For every one of the six Matrix Cases, Candidate pre- and post-execution identity or content digests are equal and attributable in the emitted evidence; otherwise validation fails.
selector_intents: Execute the six-case Matrix Case harness against a Candidate fixture deliberately mutated or replaced between its pre- and post-execution identity or content captures; the validator must fail the immutability comparison.
Execute the six-case validation with one Matrix Case omitted from Candidate-subject execution evidence; the validator must fail closed for incomplete six-case coverage.
